answer: An farming party running 187 aliases therefore needs 85 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in pearl, expire in comet, and karst lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3186 identities would post 4909 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
